title: Dela Gothic One
description: An extra-bold display gothic that can fill the frame. It suits one hard hit or a thumbnail-scale heading. The binary (Regular only, because the face is one weight) is already bundled at assets/font/dela-gothic-one/ in this repo (added 2026-08-03. The catalog side stays an index, and source below is the fetch record).
when_to_use: A thumbnail-scale extra-bold title, a hard variety one-liner, or a hype caption
ai_usage: ウェイトは用途に応じて選び分けてよい。字間・行間・カラーは overlay/テロップ側で調整してよいが、グリフ形状そのもの（フォントファイル）は改変しない
